Admission Scholarship
Enrichment
TAILORED FOR NEXT-GEN LEADERS
in Decision Analytics and Financial Engineering
The scholarship opens doors for students with exceptional academic performances to become trailblazers in the fields of Decision Analytics and Financial Engineering.
Am I eligible?
Open to all HKDSE students attaining Level 5** or 5* in one or more Category A subjects or M1 / M2 in one single sitting of HKDSE, and meet the required admission score.
Applicants must list IEDA (JS5260) as a Band A choice in JUPAS.
What are the exclusive benefits?
⭐ Admission Award
HK$ 5,000 per star achieved in HKDSE result (Level 5** / 5*)
This is an additional award on top of the Dean of Engineering Scholarship for HKDSE Holders Note
⭐ Industry-Leading Internship
Prestigious placement opportunities with industry leaders including multinational consulting firms, banking authority, media conglomerate, public utility, airlines, etc.
⭐ Global Exchange
Receive a bonus when applying to over 160 global exchange partners, including premier institutions like Northwestern University and Cornell University. ¤
⭐ Direct Entry to Elite Program
Secured placement in the Decision Analytics program with Financial Engineering concentration.
⭐ Dual Mentorship Program
Dedicated guidance from both academic faculty and industry professionals throughout your academic journey.
Note:
1. The scholarship amount listed above is awarded in addition to the admission scholarship award granted by the university and the School of Engineering based on the same HKDSE results attained. The total scholarship amount that students receive should not exceed full tuition fee plus HK$60,000 allowance p.a.
2. The subjects refer to the senior secondary subjects in Category A. Results of Applied Learning subjects and Other Language subjects will not be considered in the scholarship scheme.
3. Mathematics Extended Module 1 (Calculus & Statistics) and Mathematics Extended Module 2 (Algebra & Calculus) are also considered as independent subjects for fulfilling the requirements of the Scholarship Scheme.
4. Only HKDSE results in one single sitting will be considered.
5. The admission score is calculated based on the following formula, plus an extra bonus for their best 6th subject ♦ :
English x 2 + Math (Comp.) x 2 + Best from Biology / Chemistry / Physics / ICT#♦ + Best 2 other subjects^
#Weighting: Biology/Chemistry/Physics (x 2), ICT (x 1)
^ Weighting: M1/M2 (x 1.5), other subjects (x 1)
♦ Combined Science can also be considered a science subject, which carries a weighting of x 2
• Conversion of levels to scores (Category A Core / Elective Subjects): 5**=8.5, 5*=7, 5=5.5, 4=4, 3=3, 2=2
♦ Extra score will be awarded for the Best 6th Subject in Category A and Category C subjects. Please visit https://publication.join.ust.hk/view/13965330/18-19/ for details.
6. Successful applicants of SNDAS are also eligible.
7. Eligible students will be automatically considered for the Scheme based on their final HKDSE results.
8. ¤ Students who have attained 5* in two subjects or 5** in one subject, i.e. a total of 2 stars or more, will be granted bonus in the global exchange program application.
